- [Cove fine movement 0.4.1](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yihancheng0/ascii-game-library/main/ideas/tidebound-cove-micro.md): responsive keyboard/near clicks, finite travelling pose turns, latest-opposite priority and single-use short taps. Offline input/escort regression passed; device feel and user acceptance pending.
- [Cove clear glyphs and continuous bay 0.4.0](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yihancheng0/ascii-game-library/main/ideas/tidebound-cove-bay.md): native viewport glyphs, transparent fish compositing, coherent shore/depth/light, last-observation search. Offline input/render/regression passed; device, art and fun pending.
- [Cove immersive observation 0.3.0](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yihancheng0/ascii-game-library/main/ideas/tidebound-cove-immersion.md): full viewport and cursor-anchored zoom, travelling fish turns/rear adjustment, reachable predator attacks, explicit perception/contact rules. Offline checks passed; browser/device, art and fun pending.
- [Cove escort detail revision 0.2.0](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yihancheng0/ascii-game-library/main/ideas/tidebound-cove-refinement.md): feedback-driven rock, click response, light behavior and predator pursuit/recovery revision. Offline controls passed; device and user acceptance pending.
# ASCII 游戏素材与灵感库 / ASCII Game Library
- [Escort integration explained](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yihancheng0/ascii-game-library/main/ideas/tidebound-gameplay-integration.md): small polished escort slice, reusable companions, old/new strategies, two return outcomes and strict shared ASCII visual/interaction gates. Documentation only.

- [Tidebound research handoff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yihancheng0/ascii-game-library/main/ideas/tidebound-research-handoff.md): confirmed D-10 to D-14 directions, escort core and E0–E5 scope, current runtime, unresolved defects, references, verification boundaries and read/review scope of this handoff; further development needs user instructions.

- [Tidebound production framework](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yihancheng0/ascii-game-library/main/ideas/tidebound-framework/README.md): current draft 1.1.0-draft.2, role-based reading routes, 13 chapters, rules, object specs, calibration states and evidence gates. Documentation only; runtime stays v0.6.1. Do not treat proposed systems or pending visual baselines as implemented or accepted.
> 中文开发参考、双语标签、可读源码、逐项授权来源。Updated: 2026-10-20.

- [24 fish interactions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yihancheng0/ascii-game-library/main/catalog/fish-interactions.json): pair synergies, conflicts, counters and invalid shortcuts.
